steps.en: A daily report runs automatically at 8 am
steps.id: Report harian jalan otomatis jam 8 pagi

steps.en: Report lists refunds created the previous day
steps.id: Report mencantumkan refund yang dibuat kemarin

steps.why_en: Summary shows only a count of created refunds, no status breakdown.
steps.why_id: Ringkasan hanya jumlah refund dibuat, tanpa rincian status.

steps.en: Report shows closed and cancelled refunds
steps.id: Report menampilkan refund yang closed dan cancelled
steps.why_en: Refunds have no closed or cancelled status in the system.
steps.why_id: Refund tidak punya status closed atau cancelled di sistem.

steps.en: Report lists refund reminder letters sent
steps.id: Report mencantumkan surat reminder refund yang terkirim
steps.why_en: No refund reminder letters exist in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada surat reminder refund di sistem.

steps.why_en: Reports arrive by email; the portal has no download screen.
steps.why_id: Report datang lewat email; portal tidak punya layar unduh.
